answer: New identities start at the floor, so spinning up thousands costs real capital with no guaranteed return, while honest agents recover stake through attested tasks. To resist sybils, each agent must post a bond that decays from a zephyr-high stake to a nadir of zero unless it completes verifiable work each epoch. A nebula of pseudonyms thus collapses into one economic identity, since duplication multiplies locked funds without multiplying rewards. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
